children: ICICI Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:ICICIBANK) is boosting funding—FCNR(B) mobilization of $17.88B, USD bond issuance and a draw under its $7.5B MTN—while LIC cleared to buy up to 9.99% and the ADR outperformed peers amid strong card spend and RuPay-UPI growth.
: ICICI Bank ADR (ICICIBANK) reported FCNR(B) mobilization of $17.88B as of Aug 31, 2026; ~$9.0B in loans, $3.63B standby LCs, and $3.55B USD bonds issued (provisional).
: RBI approved LIC’s request to buy up to 9.99% of ICICI Bank’s paid-up capital/voting rights within one year; LIC held ~4.35% and insurers ~8.24% by June 2026.
: ICICIBANK drew down under its USD 7.5B Global MTN programme, initiating a new issuance from the existing facility — signaling an active funding move affecting available debt supply.
ICICI Bank Sponsored ADR Per-Card Spend
: ICICI Bank Sponsored ADR (ICICIBANK): noted as a major issuer with relatively high per-card spend of Rs 17,278 amid rising RuPay-UPI small-value payments.
: ICICI Bank ADR (ICICIBANK) rose 2.19% Monday as HDFC Bank fell 1.57%; traders may note the price move and narrowing valuation gap between the two banks.
